annotations.title: Build any-token swap (Polygon, Base, Ethereum): approve + swap, simulated

description: One call to swap ANY non-BZB token pair on Polygon (default), Base or Ethereum (chain param) through the best of KyberSwap and LI.FI (Velora fallback; same-chain only, no bridges): token-safety check (refuses blocked tokens; unverified ones need allowUnverified=true), router allowlist, exact approve, slippage (max 300 bps) and deadline guards, USD-loss cap, recipient/value calldata checks, and an eth_call simulation of the swap before returning. Returns ordered UNSIGNED txs[] plus batch (EIP-5792). BZB/BBY pairs are refused with USE_BLAZAR_ROUTE: use blazar_build_swap (fee router, earns trading rewards). Not eligible for trading rewards.

allowUnverified.description: Allow tokens whose safety verdict is caution (unverified, taxed, proxy). Blocked tokens are always refused. Default false.

amount.description: Amount of tokenIn in HUMAN units, not wei: "1.5" = 1.5 POL, "250" = 250 BZB. Set amountIsBaseUnits=true to pass wei/base units instead.

amountIsBaseUnits.description: If true, amount is in base units (wei for 18-decimal tokens; 6 decimals for USDC). Default false.

chain.description: Chain: "polygon" (default, chain 137), "base" (8453) or "ethereum" (1). BZB / BlazarSwap tools are Polygon only.

deadlineSeconds.description: Seconds until the swap expires. Default 150.

from.description: Address that will sign and send the txs. Required: used for allowance checks, simulation and nonce.

maxPriceImpactBps.description: Refuse when the output is worth more than this many bps less than the input in USD. Default 500 (5%).

provider.description: auto (default): KyberSwap and LI.FI compared, best output wins; Velora as fallback. Same-chain swaps only.

recipient.description: Who receives the output. Defaults to `from`.

slippageBps.description: Max slippage in bps (50 = 0.5%). Default 50, max 300.

tokenIn.description: Token to sell: a symbol (USDC, WETH, AAVE, LINK...; resolved only via the chain's curated list or an exact unique KyberSwap-verified match) or any 0x token address on the chosen chain. Native coin: "POL" on Polygon, "ETH" on Base / Ethereum.

tokenOut.description: Token to buy: a symbol (USDC, WETH, AAVE, LINK...; resolved only via the chain's curated list or an exact unique KyberSwap-verified match) or any 0x token address on the chosen chain. Native coin: "POL" on Polygon, "ETH" on Base / Ethereum.

name: blazar_build_any_swap

outputSchema.description: One-call build: ordered UNSIGNED txs, simulation, guards and warnings. Nothing is signed or sent.

batch.description: EIP-5792 wallet_sendCalls request with the same calls (smart wallets).

chainId.description: 137 Polygon, 8453 Base, 1 Ethereum. BlazarForce builds are always 137.
